name: もらえるお金ナビゲーター
tagline: A Japanese guide to public benefits, insurance claims and deductions you may be missing
description: Built for Japan, where money regularly goes unclaimed simply because nobody applied for it. It researches public benefits, insurance reimbursements, overpayments and deductions on official pages, then hands back a checklist of what to claim and how to ask for it, leaving the actual filing to you.
author: route20191212
